events.title: Sankranti Sambaralu & Cultural Utsav
events.campus: Main Junior College & Balaji Bhavan Grounds
events.description: A vibrant celebration of Andhra Pradesh heritage featuring traditional Telugu music, Haridasu performances, rangoli competitions, kite-flying leagues, and festive feasts across all student residential Bhavans.
highlights: Inter-Bhavan traditional rangoli design competition with cash prizes
Traditional attire showcase and folk cultural presentations
Special festive luncheon prepared using traditional methods
Honoring student cultural achievers by Dr. S. Francis Reddy
events.verificationStatus: Verified - Annual Institutional Cultural Record / YouTube Archive

events.title: Annual Prathibha Puraskaralu & Convocation
events.description: The premier institutional honors ceremony where JEE Advanced, NEET, and AP EAPCET state rankers are presented with gold medals, certificates of honor, and cash endowments in the presence of esteemed dignitaries.
highlights: Felicitation of AIR top rankers with gold medals and plaques
Distribution of ₹1.5 Crore KSR Charitable Trust merit scholarships
Keynote addresses by IIT professors and senior medical officers
Parent felicitation and emotional alumni tribute sessions

events.title: National Science Day & Research Expo
events.description: Commemorating the Raman Effect with live physics demonstrations, chemical synthesis experiments, biology micro-specimen galleries, and student innovation displays judged by guest scientists.
highlights: 50+ student-built physics and robotics demonstration models
Spectrophotometry and chemistry magic experiment lab shows
Science quiz championship with teams from all 6 Bhavans
Interactive lectures by Dogiparthi Srinivasa Rao (DSR)

events.title: Srinivasa Ramanujan National Mathematics Day
events.description: A day-long intellectual festival celebrating mathematical intuition, featuring speed mental arithmetic tournaments, non-routine geometry challenge pods, and masterclasses by Panadi Raghava.
highlights: The Oxford Ramanujan Speed Math Marathon for intermediate scholars
Paper presentations on modern applications of infinite series
Awarding the prestigious Ramanujan Junior Fellowship trophy
events.verificationStatus: Verified - Annual Department of Mathematics Record

events.title: Oxford VIT Inter-Bhavan Sports Championship
events.description: A 3-day multi-sport tournament bringing together residential and day-scholar teams competing in cricket, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, and rapid chess.
highlights: Night-floodlit inter-campus volleyball and cricket finals
Individual championship trophies for track sprint events
Certified medical and physiotherapy teams on standby

events.title: KSR Charitable Trust Rural Health & Educational Outreach
events.description: Annual social responsibility campaign providing free diagnostic health camps, distribution of academic textbooks, and educational counselling for economically disadvantaged students.
highlights: Free multi-specialty health check-ups for 1,200+ local families
Distribution of notebooks, stationery and scholarship kits
Led by Founder K. Sambasiva Rao and student volunteer council
